items.title: Roboflow explains routing images in Workflows with the OpenAI Decisions Switch block
items.description: The Roboflow Blog describes routing each image in a Roboflow Workflow to one branch using the OpenAI Decisions Switch block, which prompts GPT-6 Luna and runs the case that clears a probability threshold.

items.title: Roboflow describes building vision AI apps with plain prompts for citizen developers
items.description: The Roboflow Blog describes building, training, and deploying vision AI apps with plain prompts using Roboflow Agent, MCP, or ChatGPT, aimed at citizen developers.

items.title: State AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from auctioning off users' chat histories
items.description: Engadget reports that state attorneys general are attempting to block Character.AI's proposed sale of user chat histories, which officials say would include explicit conversations with children.

items.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
items.description: TechCrunch reports OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences, meaning heavy users may reach limits sooner.

items.title: Roboflow outlines a workflow from foundation model labeling to production vision models
items.description: The Roboflow blog describes labeling images with Gemini, checking labels, querying annotations to find objects at the frame edge, selecting diverse training images, training RF-DETR, deploying to cloud or edge, and using active learning.

items.title: Roboflow describes teacher-student training workflow for defect detection models
items.description: The Roboflow blog post describes training a defect detection model using teacher-student training: auto-labeling with a teacher model, reviewing the labels, and training RF-DETR in Roboflow.

items.title: Roboflow explains when to use anomaly detection versus object detection
items.description: The Roboflow blog post explains that anomaly detection learns what good looks like from good images alone, while object detection finds labeled defects, and describes when each approach fits visual inspection and when to use both.

items.title: ZDNET explains how to turn Claude artifacts into Windows and Mac desktop apps
items.description: ZDNET reports that Anthropic's new 'install as app' feature makes it easy to turn Claude artifacts into desktop apps on Windows and Mac computers, noting some limitations.

items.title: Hugging Face blog lists an Allen AI piece on where scientists draw the line on AI agents
items.description: The video description presents a Hugging Face blog listing titled 'Where scientists draw the line on AI agents.' No excerpt is available, so the piece's specific arguments cannot be summarized.

items.title: Google Research blog post on verifiable social reasoning for LLM assistants
items.description: The Google Research Blog lists a post titled 'Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants' under the category Generative AI. The available excerpt is too thin to describe the work's content.

items.title: Nvidia fallout exposes China's fragility on frontier AI, FT reports
items.description: The Financial Times reports that the Nvidia fallout exposes China's fragility on frontier AI, attributing the difficulty to a lack of US-style capital markets and domestic commercial demand for fueling innovation.

items.title: New York enacts five-year ban on AI chatbot-powered toys, The Guardian reports
items.description: The Guardian reports New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed legislation imposing a five-year ban on manufacturing and selling toys powered by AI chatbots, including talking stuffed animals, dolls and robots that converse with children online; the attorney general says she would not hesitate to enforce it.

items.title: FT examines why economists struggle to forecast AI's economic impact
items.description: The Financial Times reports that frontier labs and officials offer widely divergent predictions for AI-driven growth in the coming years, complicating economic forecasting.

items.title: Gradient Flow defines the agent data runtime as a new data layer for AI agents
items.description: Ben Lorica's Gradient Flow argues the data stack becomes less forgiving as AI agents make decisions, since stale records, inconsistent definitions and incorrect permissions can cause operational failures, and introduces the concept of an agent data runtime.

items.title: ElevenLabs pitches AI voice agents as a replacement for government IVR phone menus
items.description: ElevenLabs's blog post argues that outdated IVR phone menus are the front door to government for millions and that governments are now adopting AI agents for several kinds of calls.
